brief:
Israeli settlers suspected of attacking a journalist and diplomats have been released, Middle East Eye reported. Details of the attack and circumstances surrounding the arrests were not specified in the available information.

The incident comes amid ongoing tensions involving Israeli settlers and international observers in the region. A separate video circulating online appeared to show an Israeli soldier abusing a cat, with authorities investigating the matter.

title: Israeli settlers suspected of attacking journalist, diplomats released
